# Repo-Wiki Templates

Bundled templates for LLM-maintained codebase wiki pages under `docs/<scenario>-<slug>/wiki/`.

| Template | Output | Description |
|----------|--------|-------------|
| `index.md.template` | `index.md` | Content catalog for overview, modules, concepts, risks, and sources. |
| `log.md.template` | `log.md` | Append-only chronological activity log with parseable headings. |
| `module-page.template.md` | `modules/<module-slug>.md` | Token-mindful module/component page with links, APIs, dependencies, flows, risks, and sources. |
